    The maximal submodule annihilated by a two-sided ideal #

    For a two-sided ideal I and a finitely generated right A-module M, this file constructs the largest submodule of M annihilated by I. Bundled in the annihilated full subcategory, this is the right adjoint needed to restrict ambient right almost-split maps to mod (A/I).

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.isAnnihilatedBy_biproduct {A : Type u} [Ring A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (I : TwoSidedIdeal A) {J : Type} [Fintype J] (F : J → FinitelyGeneratedCategory A) (hF : ∀ (j : J), IsAnnihilatedBy I (F j)) :
    IsAnnihilatedBy I (⨁ F)

    A finite biproduct of modules annihilated by I is again annihilated by I.
